product_overview: MARL EXPRESS ERP is a high-volume logistics ERP for creating airway bill bookings, maintaining centralized master data, and managing manual cargo tracking with Proof of Delivery (POD). It is designed for transaction safety, fast operator workflows, and reliable AJAX-based operations.
core_goals: Enable atomic shipment booking creation and management for high-volume AWB workflows
Provide centralized master data listings for customers, transporters, drivers, and airlines
Support chronological manual tracking updates with POD attachment and hard-delete controls
Ensure reliable AJAX responses and avoid data loss, truncation, and session shutdown issues
Keep logistics data isolated by active company/tenant context

features.name: Shipment Booking Management
features.description: Create, view, list, and delete AWB shipment bookings with transactional safety.
user_flows: GET /logistics with authenticated session -> Receive dashboard with recent bookings
GET /logistics/manage with authenticated session -> Receive bookings management view
POST /logistics/ajax-datatable with search and pagination parameters -> Receive 200 with server-side bookings dataset
POST /logistics/delete/{id} with a valid booking id -> Receive 200 and booking plus child shipment items are deleted atomically
POST /logistics/delete/{id} with an invalid or missing id -> Receive an error response and no booking is deleted

features.name: Courier Manual Tracking & POD
features.description: Record and manage chronological transit logs, including optional Proof of Delivery uploads.
user_flows: GET /tracking/history/{booking_id} with authenticated session -> Receive 200 with chronological tracking history for the docket
POST /tracking/save with booking_id, status, location, event date/time, and optional POD file -> Receive 200 and a new or updated tracking record is saved
POST /tracking/save with invalid required tracking fields -> Receive an error response and no tracking record is committed
POST /tracking/delete/{id} with a valid tracking record id -> Receive 200 and the tracking record is permanently removed
POST /tracking/delete/{id} with a non-existent id -> Receive an error response and the database remains unchanged

features.name: Master Data Management
features.description: List and manage centralized master records used during logistics operations, including customers, airlines, transporters, and drivers.
user_flows: POST /masters/ajax-datatable/{type} with a valid master type and search/pagination inputs -> Receive 200 with a paginated master listing
POST /masters/ajax-datatable/{type} with an unsupported master type -> Receive an error response and no dataset is returned
POST /masters/ajax-datatable/{type} with authenticated session and filter criteria -> Receive 200 with filtered rows for the selected master category
